heading: Short title, extent and commencement
title: Short title, extent and commencement
text:
(1) This Act may be cited as the Punjab Rented Premises Act 2009.
(2) It extends to the whole of the Punjab.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

heading: Act to override other laws

text: The provisions of this Act shall have effect notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force.

heading: Agreement between landlord and tenant in writing and registered with Rent Registrar
title: Agreement between landlord and tenant in writing and registered with Rent Registrar
text:
(1) A tenancy agreement shall be in writing and shall be registered with the Rent Registrar of the area.
(2) The Rent Registrar shall maintain a register of tenancy agreements in such form and manner as may be prescribed.

heading: Payment of rent by bank deposit, cheque or receipt
title: Payment of rent by bank deposit, cheque or receipt
text:
(1) A tenant shall pay or tender the rent to the landlord in the mode and by the date specified in the tenancy agreement.
(2) If no date is specified in the tenancy agreement, the tenant shall pay or tender the rent not later than the tenth day of the month following the month for which the rent is payable.

heading: Filing of application for eviction or other relief
title: Filing of application for eviction or other relief
text:
(1) An application in respect of a rented premises shall be filed in the Rent Tribunal of the area or the district.
(2) If an application is filed under sub-section (1), the Administrative Special Judge (Rent) of the area or the district may take cognizance of the case or entrust the same to any other Special Judge (Rent).
(3) An application under sub-section (1) shall contain a concise statement of facts, the relief claimed and shall be accompanied by copies of all relevant documents in possession of the applicant.

(3) An application under sub-section (1) shall contain a concise statement of facts, the relief claimed and shall be accompanied by copies of all relevant documents in possession of the applicant.

heading: Appearance of parties and consequences of non-appearance
title: Appearance of parties and consequences of non-appearance
text:
(1) The Rent Tribunal shall issue notice to the respondent in the prescribed manner.
(2) If the respondent fails to appear on the date fixed, the Rent Tribunal may proceed ex parte and pass an order of eviction or dismissal as the case may be.

heading: Leave to contest eviction application; affidavit showing reasonable grounds
title: Leave to contest eviction application; affidavit showing reasonable grounds
text:
(1) The Rent Tribunal shall not allow a respondent to defend the application unless he files an application for leave to contest supported by an affidavit within ten days of his appearance before the Rent Tribunal.
(2) The Rent Tribunal may grant leave to contest if the application discloses plausible grounds of defence.
(3) If the application for leave to contest is not filed within the specified period, or if the Rent Tribunal refuses to grant leave to contest, the Rent Tribunal shall pass an eviction order forthwith.

(2) The Rent Tribunal may grant leave to contest if the application discloses plausible grounds of defence.
(3) If the application for leave to contest is not filed within the specified period, or if the Rent Tribunal refuses to grant leave to contest, the Rent Tribunal shall pass an eviction order forthwith.
